def VTask.setValue : {α : Sort u_1} → {β : Sort u_2} → (f : α ↪ β) → (a : α) → (b : β) → [(a' : α) → Decidable (a' = a)] → [(a' : α) → Decidable (f a' = b)] → α ↪ β
  | α, β, f, a, b, decEq, decImg =>
    let g : α → β := λ x => if h : x = a then b else if h2 : f x = b then f a else f x
    have inj_g : Function.Injective g :=
      λ x y h_eq =>
        match (decEq x, decEq y) with
        | (isTrue rfl, isTrue rfl) => rfl
        | (isTrue rfl, isFalse hna) =>
          match decImg y with
          | isTrue hfy =>
            let h1 : f y = b := hfy
            let h2 : b = f a := Eq.substr h_eq (if_pos rfl) (if_pos hfy)
            let eq_f := Eq.trans h1 h2
            let eq_y_a := f.injective eq_f
            Eq.substr hna eq_y_a
          | isFalse hfy =>
            let eq_b_fy : b = f y := Eq.substr h_eq (if_pos rfl) (if_neg hfy)
            let h1 : f y = b := Eq.symm eq_b_fy
            let eq_x_a := f.injective (Eq.trans h1 (Eq.symm rfl))
            Eq.substr hna eq_x_a
        | (isFalse hna, isTrue rfl) =>
          match decImg x with
          | isTrue hfx =>
            let h1 : f x = b := hfx
            let h2 : b = f a := Eq.substr h_eq.symm (if_neg hna) (if_pos hfx)
            let eq_f := Eq.trans h1 h2
            let eq_x_a := f.injective eq_f
            Eq.substr hna eq_x_a
          | isFalse hfx =>
            let eq_b_fx : b = f x := Eq.substr h_eq.symm (if_neg hna) (if_neg hfx)
            let h1 : f x = b := Eq.symm eq_b_fx
            let eq_x_a := f.injective (Eq.trans h1 (Eq.symm rfl))
            Eq.substr hna eq_x_a
        | (isFalse hna, isFalse hna') =>
          match (decImg x, decImg y) with
          | (isTrue hfx, isTrue hfy) =>
            let eq_f := Eq.trans hfx hfy.symm
            eq_f
          | (isTrue hfx, isFalse hfy) =>
            let eq_fa_fy : f a = f y := Eq.substr h_eq (if_neg hna) (if_pos hfx) (if_neg hfy)
            let eq_a_y := f.injective eq_fa_fy
            Eq.substr hna' eq_a_y
          | (isFalse hfx, isTrue hfy) =>
            let eq_fx_fa : f x = f a := Eq.substr h_eq.symm (if_neg hna') (if_neg hfx) (if_pos hfy)
            let eq_x_a := f.injective eq_fx_fa
            Eq.substr hna eq_x_a
          | (isFalse hfx, isFalse hfy) =>
            let eq_fx_fy : f x = f y := Eq.substr h_eq (if_neg hna) (if_neg hfx) (if_neg hfy)
            f.injective eq_fx_fy
    { toFun := g, inj' := inj_g }
